nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Collector for course_id=7 "Creative Computing & Culture (Fall 2014)": fetch the full quiz-submission records for every quiz in its course (canvas quiz-submission listing, per_page=100, follow pagination.has_page/pagination.has_more, and always read the FULL JSON from the output_path file when the chat preview is truncated); count every recorded submission regardless of date; compute per quiz Submissions (count), Avg_Score, Min_Score, Max_Score over the submission scores; aggregate at course level Total_Quizzes, Total_Submissions, and Overall_Avg_Score = sum(avg_score * submissions) / sum(submissions); and return ONLY the compact JSON {course_id, course_name, quizzes: [{quiz_title, submissions, avg_score, min_score, max_score}], total_quizzes, total_submissions, overall_avg_score}. Strictly read-only with respect to Canvas; do not write workspace files, do not return the raw row set.
